name: empathy
title_zh: 动笔前先过一遍人类沟通守则的 AI 礼貌开关
tagline_zh: PR、评论、邮件、聊天……凡是人要看的话，它都先拦一道。不是改措辞，是让你想清楚该不该说、怎么说，再开口。
tagline_en: PRs, issues, replies, emails, chats—anything a person reads gets a pre-check. Not a rewrite, but a pause to ask.
desc_en: Rules for communicating with humans as an AI agent. Read in full BEFORE composing any text another person will read: PR titles and descriptions, issues, code review replies, comments, discussion summaries, emails, chat and forum posts, commit messages, changelogs. Also before replying when someone responds to you, and before deciding whether to post at all. Do not draft first and check after. Mini
why_zh: 它把「沟通规则」前置成写作前的强制检查，而不是写完后补救。你还没落笔，它已帮你避开冷硬、含糊、冒犯的坑。
why_en: It enforces communication rules as a pre-writing gate, not a post-hoc fix. Before you type, it already steers you clear of cold.
limit_zh: 只约束文本沟通，不处理语音、代码逻辑或视觉输出；且需你主动在每次写作前调用，不会自动拦截后台生成内容。
limit_en: Text-only; no speech, code logic, or visuals. Requires manual activation per writing task—won't auto-scan background-generated content.
title_en: Human-communication rule check before any text you write
